description_en: Set to `1` to force-enable the byte-level streaming idle watchdog, or set to `0` to force-disable it. When unset, the watchdog is enabled by default for Anthropic API connections. The byte watchdog aborts a connection when no bytes arrive on the wire for the duration set by `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS`, with a minimum of 5 minutes, independent of the event-level watchdog
description_ja: バイトレベルのストリーミング監視(ウォッチドッグ)の有効無効を強制的に切り替えます。
